special_locations.name: Mossbound Shrine
special_locations.description: A keeper shrine still warm beneath curtains of moss.

special_locations.name: Lantern Well
special_locations.description: Pale fungal lanterns circle water untouched by the ruin.

special_locations.name: Root Oracle
special_locations.description: Living roots have grown into a map of rooms yet unseen.

special_locations.name: Cinder Engine
special_locations.description: An ancient lift engine breathes sparks through cracked brass lungs.

special_locations.name: Drowned Archive
special_locations.description: Crystal tablets sleep beneath perfectly clear runoff.

special_locations.name: Crown Thorn
special_locations.description: A root from the tower crown pierces the floor and tests every trespasser.

special_locations.name: Echo Nursery
special_locations.description: Empty stone cradles hum with the memory of tower-born eggs.

special_locations.name: Waykeeper Camp
special_locations.description: A forgotten expedition camp waits behind a still-burning ward.

special_locations.name: Bellwright Forge
special_locations.description: Tiny hammers hover above an anvil tuned to the tower's heartbeat.

special_locations.name: Moonwell Chartroom
special_locations.description: Silver water reflects corridors that do not appear on the walls.

special_locations.name: Broken Observatory
special_locations.description: A root-pierced lens still tracks the crown through ten floors of stone.

special_locations.name: Crown Antechamber
special_locations.description: Tribute bowls line the final threshold beneath a listening canopy.

special_locations.name: Whispering Cartographer
special_locations.description: A paper-thin keeper inks moving rooms onto strips of shed bark.

special_locations.name: Hunter's Cairn
special_locations.description: Claw-marked stones hold the scent trail of everything stalking this floor.

special_locations.name: Rootglass Conservatory
special_locations.description: Medicinal vines grow behind panes warmed by a buried ember pipe.

special_locations.name: Flooded Menagerie
special_locations.description: Half-submerged nest cages sway in water disturbed by unseen fins.

special_locations.name: Sunken Signal Loft
special_locations.description: A drowned beacon waits for crystal light to reach the rooms beyond.

special_locations.name: Last Waystation
special_locations.description: The final keeper post still holds sealed flare tubes and a hunter ward.

events.name: Keeper's Blessing
events.narrative: The shrine's old warmth settles over the party.

events.name: Living Offering
events.narrative: The offering bowl erupts into a territorial moss mite.

events.name: Restorative Draught
events.narrative: Cool light follows the water and closes the party's wounds.

events.name: Lantern Swarm
events.narrative: The nearest lights unfold into hungry wings.

events.name: Buried Route
events.narrative: The root-map points toward supplies sealed inside the wall.

events.name: Oracle's Warning
events.narrative: A vision of the crown arrives with the weight of distant attention.

events.name: Engine Salvage
events.narrative: The party coaxes intact ore and coins from the dormant mechanism.

events.name: Engine Backdraft
events.narrative: The engine wakes violently, filling the chamber with heat and noise.

events.name: Archive Dividend
events.narrative: One tablet dissolves into a fistful of memory-bright crystal.

events.name: Reflected Hunger
events.narrative: The reflection moves first; glass leeches rise from the tablets.

events.name: Thorn-Held Cache
events.narrative: Behind the crown thorn, old tribute waits for a steady hand.

events.name: Crown's Notice
events.narrative: The thorn rings like a bell and a guardian answers.

events.name: Wake a Cradle
events.narrative: One stone cradle answers with a pulse of violet light.

events.name: Join the Chorus
events.narrative: The party matches the nursery's low song until the stone grows warm.

events.name: Rekindle the Ward
events.narrative: The old ward circles the party in a quiet amber ring.

events.name: Search the Packs
events.narrative: The waykeepers left dry supplies beneath an oilskin map.

events.name: Tune the Bell
events.narrative: The forge yields ore as its suspended hammers find the lost note.

events.name: Muffle the Anvil
events.narrative: Wrapped in moss and cloth, the anvil's heartbeat fades from the tower.

events.name: Reach Into the Reflection
events.narrative: The reflected hand returns holding an egg cold with moonlight.

events.name: Trace the Reflected Routes
events.narrative: Silver corridors settle into the expedition map before the water stills.

events.name: Align the Crown Lens
events.narrative: The lens sketches every passable route in a single green flare.

events.name: Gather Fallen Light
events.narrative: Fragments caught beneath the lens cool into usable crystal.

events.name: Accept the Old Tribute
events.narrative: The deepest bowl opens around an egg marked with the living crown.

events.name: Answer the Canopy
events.narrative: The party's answer returns in the footfall of a crown hand.

events.name: Trade for the Signal Marks
events.narrative: The cartographer burns fresh room signs into two waiting flare tubes.

events.name: Take the Living Map
events.narrative: The bark-map shrieks as it is torn free, calling a vault hunter.

events.name: Scatter the Scent Stones
events.narrative: Earthwise paws grind the marked cairn into a dozen false trails.

events.name: Follow the Freshest Mark
events.narrative: The trail reaches a stashed purse one heartbeat before its owner.

events.name: Prune the Medicinal Vines
events.narrative: Careful heat frees mature cuttings without cracking the rootglass.

events.name: Break the Warm Panes
events.narrative: The party gathers crystal and herbs as the conservatory vents into the tower.

events.name: Open the Quiet Nest
events.narrative: A water-tuned touch releases the cage without waking the deep pool.

events.name: Drain the Lower Cages
events.narrative: The sluice opens, along with the plated beast nesting against it.

events.name: Relight the Signal Loft
events.narrative: Crystal fire sketches distant rooms and primes the old flare rack.

events.name: Ring the Drowned Beacon
events.narrative: The beacon answers with a garden shade rising through the flooded floor.

events.name: Open the Flare Reserve
events.narrative: Old keeper seals yield enough light to finish charting the crownward route.

events.name: Wake the Hunter Ward
events.narrative: A low green pulse clears stalking shadows from every marked chamber.
